entry.notes: Bescheidenes, eher älteres Wort für die eigene Ehefrau („meine Frau“). Weil 家内 wörtlich „im Haus“ bedeutet, meiden es heute viele und sagen 妻; über die Frau anderer spricht man mit 奥さん.

secondPass.finding: Second pass: 家内【かない】 N4 Nomen. The meaning "(meine) Ehefrau" is present, is idiomatic German and is supported by the selected JMdict senses. Examples, romaji, note, level and pitch (verified 1) were re-checked. Round-1 fix verified: the note now correctly says 妻 replaces 家内 and 奥さん is for other people's wives, and ex2 German reads "zu einer heißen Quelle gefahren". Round-1 notes: The note is muddled: it says 家内 is "replaced by 妻 or 奥さん (für die Frau anderer)", but 奥さん is not a replacement for one's own-wife 家内 (it is normally used for other people's wives). The reason it is avoided (wife "inside the house") should be stated clearly. In ex2, "in eine heiße Quelle gefahren" is awkward German.
